metadata.title: Dhangari Gaja Folk dance | सांगली, महाराष्ट्र का धांगडी गज लोक नृत्य
metadata.description:
Folk artists of Sangli, Maharashtra performed Dhangari Gaja folk dance, depicting the process of pleasing Goddess Parvati when she gets angry. The main attraction of this traditional dance is a procession with beautifully decorated flag umbrellas in hands of the dancers. The artist told us that they are performing this dance from generation to generation. 
#CGTribalFest2022 #adivasi
